text:
Jules (People Ops): Tiny toolkit: a 3-minute self-review ICs can paste, a micro-guide managers can use in 1:1s, and a short numeric calibration shorthand (0-2). Super short so teams actually use it.
Anya (Eng Manager): love the small stuff. can you also give a 1-line email subject I can use when asking for reviews?
Jules (People Ops): Email subject (paste): "Request: 3-min self-review for mid-cycle check (due EOD Wed)"
Marcus (SWE): ok drop the 3-min self-review we can paste into the form.
Jules (People Ops): 3-min self-review (copy/paste):
"Role & scope: [one line]. Top impact this cycle: [one sentence with metric or link]. One blocker I need help with: [one short ask]. Growth request next period: [one short ask]."
Felix (Design): can managers get a micro-guide for the 1:1?
Jules (People Ops): Manager micro-guide (20m):
- 2m: read self-review headline aloud
- 6m: ask clarifying Qs, surface evidence links
- 8m: decide 1 concrete manager action (who does what by when)
- 4m: career pulse + next step
Anya (Eng Manager): nice. what's the numeric calibration shorthand? we've used all sorts and this sounds simpler.
Jules (People Ops): Quickscore (0-2):
0 = No measurable progress / blocked
1 = Some progress; needs help to reach target
2 = Clear measurable progress or exceeded target
Add one short evidence link for each score.
Marcus (SWE): any sample filled self-review so folks get the tone?
Jules (People Ops): example (very short):
"Role & scope: Backend SWE working on query planner. Top impact: Reduced median planning time 40% (dashboard link). Blocker: need infra quota increase to run long tails. Growth: lead cross-team perf design review next sprint."
Felix (Design): can we have a peer micro-ask that's anonymous-friendly?
Jules (People Ops): Peer micro-ask (optional anonymous): "In 1-2 bullets, what did this person do that helped you ship? What's one small improvement?" Use survey tool with anonymous flag if you want candid feedback.
Anya (Eng Manager): managers sometimes need a one-liner when giving corrective feedback mid-cycle. any concise phrasing?
Jules (People Ops): Corrective micro-script (one-liner + one action):
"I want to align on expectation X — here's the evidence I see. Proposed change: do Y this cycle. Can we try that and sync in 2 weeks?"
Marcus (SWE): how do we schedule a reminder for teams? we've used the other bot commands.
SprintBot: Use `/perf nudge create --when midpoint --offset -14d --team @team` to create a 2-week-before-midpoint nudge. See /docs/perf/nudges for examples.
Anya (Eng Manager): will start using the 3-min template in our recurring invites. thanks!
Jules (People Ops): version v3.0-compact. If you adapt it for role-specific needs, post the new version tag and a 1-line summary here so People Ops can track changes. Thanks :sparkles:
